  pn.pizza_name,
  TRIM(t.val) as topping_id_str,
  tp.topping_name as standard_topping
FROM orders o
JOIN pizza_names pn ON o.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(STR_SPLIT((SELECT r.toppings FROM pizza_recipes r WHERE r.pizza_id = o.pizza_id), ',')) AS t(val) ON TRUE
JOIN pizza_toppings tp ON tp.topping_id = t.val::INT
LIMIT 15

    o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_id, o.exclusions, o.extras, o.order_time,
    pn.pizza_name,
    tp.topping_name as topping
  FROM orders o
  JOIN pizza_names pn ON o.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(STR_SPLIT((SELECT r.toppings FROM pizza_recipes r WHERE r.pizza_id = o.pizza_id), ',')) AS t(val)
  JOIN pizza_toppings tp ON tp.topping_id = t.val::INT
),
excluded_toppings AS (
  SELECT 
    o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_id, o.exclusions, o.extras, o.order_time,
    pn.pizza_name,
    tp.topping_name as topping
  FROM orders o
  JOIN pizza_names pn ON o.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(STR_SPLIT(o.exclusions, ',')) AS t(val)
  JOIN pizza_toppings tp ON tp.topping_id = t.val::INT
  WHERE o.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND o.exclusions != ''
),
extra_toppings AS (
  SELECT 
    o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_id, o.exclusions, o.extras, o.order_time,
    pn.pizza_name,
    tp.topping_name as topping
  FROM orders o
  JOIN pizza_names pn ON o.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(STR_SPLIT(o.extras, ',')) AS t(val)
  JOIN pizza_toppings tp ON tp.topping_id = t.val::INT
  WHERE o.extras IS NOT NULL AND o.extras != ''
),
all_toppings AS (
  SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time, pizza_name, topping
  FROM standard_toppings
  UNION ALL
  SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time, pizza_name, topping
  FROM extra_toppings
),
final_toppings AS (
  SELECT at.row_id, at.order_id, at.customer_id, at.pizza_id, at.extras, at.order_time, at.pizza_name, at.topping
  FROM all_toppings at
  LEFT JOIN excluded_toppings et ON at.row_id = et.row_id AND at.topping = et.topping
  WHERE et.topping IS NULL
)
SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM final_toppings
GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping
ORDER BY row_id, topping
LIMIT 25
